text.p: - Before the operation, any effort could cause pain. Now it is gone, said Naina Yeltsin about her husband's health in an interview with the paper on Monday.
- The State Duma, Russia's lower house of Parliament, declined to compromise with the government over the draft 1997 budget. This coflict may lead to a serious political scandal.
- Resolving the political crisis in Belarus depends on Russia's position.
- The Russian Emergency Tax Commission wants to tighten control over production and import of spirits.
- The neighbours of Belarus express their concern about the situation in the republic.
- Boris Berezovsky is on top of the list of 50 most influential businessmen in Russia
- Russia's output of gold can reach 300 tonnes per year in the near future if enough money is invested in the industry.
- While the Belarussian president and his supporters are experiencing a lot of pressure from the outside, the people should decide the most important questions put forward for the referendum.
- Russia's former national security chief Alexander Lebed promised to return to big politics during a visit to the United States.
